text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Organized paragraphs that systematically expand on learning lessons, finding new methods, and applying tactics with specific examples like a homicide detective.","quality":"Coherent Organizational Structure","description":"Captures the writer's ability to arrange ideas logically and develop a clear thematic progression throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"Correct use of complex sentence patterns such as \"when a problem is present you have an opportunity to learn a lesson and keep trying to solve the problem until you find the answer to it.\"","quality":"Grammatical Accuracy and Complexity","description":"Reflects the mastery of syntactical structures and grammatical rules that produce clear, sophisticated sentences."},{"evidence":"Appropriate use of abstract and domain-specific vocabulary such as \"investigating,\" \"corporate [culprit],\" \"tactics,\" and \"homicide case.\"","quality":"Vocabulary Control and Appropriateness","description":"Measures the student's ability to select precise, varied, and context-appropriate words to express ideas clearly."},{"evidence":"Demonstrates basic punctuation and standard capitalization throughout, in contrast to pervasive formatting and mechanical errors.","quality":"Mechanics and Orthography","description":"Captures the adherence to standard conventions of spelling, capitalization, and punctuation that ensure readability."}]}
